title: The Spirit and the Word
definition: The Spirit and the Word belong together because the Holy Spirit inspired Scripture and uses Scripture to reveal Christ, convict sin, and sanctify believers.
summary: The Holy Spirit works through the Word He inspired.
christFocus: Jesus is revealed through Scripture, and the Spirit opens hearts to receive His truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit does not compete with the Word. He inspired Scripture and continues to work through Scripture in the hearts of God's people.

The Word without dependence on the Spirit can become cold information. Claimed spirituality without the Word becomes unstable and dangerous.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some believers divide Word-centered faith from Spirit-filled life. This doctrine matters because faithful Christianity needs both the inspired Word and the Spirit's living work.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture prayerfully and dependently. Ask the Spirit to open your eyes, reveal Christ, convict sin, and produce obedience.
